pick.name: Microsoft Store (MSIX; Store re-signs) + winget listing
pick.what: Submit MSIX; Microsoft signs after certification; winget can point users to it
pick.why: Only $0, worldwide, no-SmartScreen route open to an India-based developer
pick.free_limits: Free individual developer account (storedeveloper.microsoft.com); MSIX re-signed by Microsoft free after certification. MSI/EXE Store submissions are NOT re-signed and must be Authenticode-signed with a cert chaining to a Microsoft Trusted Root Program CA (self-signed not accepted).

alts.name: OV code-signing certificate (Sectigo/DigiCert/SSL.com/Certum) on HSM/cloud signing
alts.why: Needed for direct EXE/NSIS downloads without warnings building over time
alts.free_limits: approx $150-300/yr (unverified, vendor-dependent); Certum OSS cert cheaper (unverified)

alts.name: SignPath Foundation
alts.what: Free signing for genuine OSS projects
alts.free_limits: OSI licence, no proprietary components or dual-licensing

candidates.name: OV cert
candidates.verdict: Buy only when enterprise clients need direct-download EXE/MSI.

candidates.name: SignPath Foundation
candidates.verdict: Only for the fully-OSS parts of open core.

candidates.name: Azure Artifact Signing
candidates.verdict: Not available: Public Trust orgs only in US/CA/EU/UK/AU/NZ/JP/KR/SG/CH/NO/IL, individuals US/CA (quickstart, updated 2026-10-08); a non-Indian legal entity would qualify.

candidates.name: EV certificate
candidates.verdict: No longer bypasses SmartScreen; not worth the premium.

candidates.name: winget only / unsigned
candidates.verdict: Unsigned installers trigger SmartScreen; winget is a channel, not signing.

decision: Ship through the Microsoft Store as MSIX so Microsoft signs it for free, and add a winget manifest for developers. Buy an OV cert only when a B2B buyer insists on a direct MSI; Artifact Signing (~$9.99/mo) becomes possible only if you form a company in an eligible country.
details: Consolidates Artifact Signing country list expanded since AU, NZ, JP, KR, SG, CH, NO, IL for orgs) but still not India.

verify.note: Store MSIX free re-signing, worldwide availability and free developer account confirmed. Error: MSI/EXE Store submissions must be signed with a cert chaining to a Microsoft Trusted Root Program CA; self-signed certs are NOT accepted (file says 'self-signed with a trusted CA cert'). Artifact Signing India exclusion confirmed by the quickstart (updated 2026-10-08); the older code-signing-options page (2026-08-29) still lists only US/CA/EU/UK.
